description: Implementation of a thread pool for the Caffe2 framework, including thread management, task execution, and platform-specific thread count determination.

classes.name: ThreadPoolImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the ThreadPool interface managing thread creation, task scheduling, and execution.

methods.name: getDefaultNumThreads
methods.description: Calculates the default number of threads based on hardware and platform-specific caps.

methods.name: ThreadPool::createThreadPool
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ThreadPool instance with specified number of threads.

methods.name: ThreadPool::defaultThreadPool
methods.description: Creates and returns a default thread pool with a platform-optimized number of threads.

methods.name: ThreadPoolImpl::run
methods.description: Executes a function over a range, either locally or using multiple threads.

methods.name: ThreadPoolImpl::withPool
methods.description: Provides access to the internal WorkersPool for custom operations.
